_note: Pairs check [10] flags as probable duplicates that a human has judged distinct. Each entry records why, so the check stays quiet on them and loud on new pairs. Add a pair only after reading both fields' descriptions and citations; if you cannot say why they differ, they are probably duplicates.

pairs.why: Nameplate rated capacity at manufacture (Annex XIII 1(g)) vs the in-service value of the Annex IV Part A(1) parameter (Annex XIII 4(a)).
Declared expected lifetime at placing on the market vs the value updated in service when the battery's status changes (Annex XIII 4(a)).
Whole-product recycled share vs the plastic-specific share.
Whole-product recycled share vs the metal-specific share.
Refrigerating appliance total volume vs the frozen-compartment volume (Reg. 2019/2016 Annex V lists both).
Recycled share of the textile product vs of its packaging.
Tread depth of the new tyre vs the legal minimum before replacement (1.6 mm, Dir. 2014/45/EU Annex I).
Whole-tyre recycled share vs the rubber-specific share.
Legal name vs registered trade name; Battery Regulation Annex VI Part A(1) names both.
Headline figure vs one of its two state-of-charge points (Annex XIII 1(i)). Whether the headline field should exist at all is part of the open Annex XIII review.
Headline figure vs one of its two state-of-charge points (Annex XIII 1(i)). Whether the headline field should exist at all is part of the open Annex XIII review.
EN 15804+A2 reports GWP-total and its sub-indicators separately; the total is their sum.

EN 15804+A2 reports GWP-total and its sub-indicators separately; the total is their sum.
Different appliances under different acts: washing machines (Reg. 2019/2014 Annex V) vs refrigerating appliances (Reg. 2019/2016 Annex V). The washing-machine key is just named generically.
Refrigerating appliance total volume vs the fresh-food compartment (Reg. 2019/2016 Annex V lists both).
Total recycled share vs its post-consumer part.
Total recycled share vs its pre-consumer part.
Country of extraction vs the specific mine.
Material of the packaging component vs the material category a recycled-content figure is declared for (PPWR Art. 7 minima differ by plastic category).
Measured empty space vs the legal ceiling (PPWR Art. 24(1)).

contrasts.why: Different chemical elements. The law sets a separate share or limit for each: Battery Regulation Art. 8 (cobalt, lead, lithium, nickel), CRMA Art. 29(1) (eight magnet elements, per element), REACH Annex XVII (lead, cadmium).
Pre-consumer and post-consumer recycled material are separate shares; post-consumer is what Battery Regulation Art. 8 and CRMA Art. 29 count.
Levels of the battery hierarchy; Annex XIII 1(o) asks for internal resistance at pack level and, where possible, at module and cell level.
Opposite electrodes with different active materials.
Value declared at placing on the market (Battery Regulation Annex XIII point 1) vs the state-of-health value in service (Annex XIII 4(b)).
Power capability at 20% and 80% state of charge, the two points of the Annex XIII 1(i) figure.
Different material classes, each with its own recycled share.
Different economic operators, each identified separately.
Different textile production stages, whose locations are declared separately.
